---
title: "Resources"
---

Documents and references for the teaching unit.

- [Fiche d'unité DAI 2026–2027](resources/fiche-unite-dai-2026-2027.pdf):
  the official description of the unit (objectives, content, grading).
- [Utilisation des outils d'IA — Principes](resources/ia-principes-heig-vd.pdf):
  the HEIG-VD guidelines for using AI tools in your work.
- [Past evaluations](resources/past-evaluations/index.qmd): tests given in previous
  years in the DAI course of L. Delafontaine and H. Louis, on which this course is based,
  with their answers. Use them to practise only: the tests of this course can be
  entirely different.
- [Java networking documentation](https://docs.oracle.com/javase/tutorial/networking/index.html):
  the official Java documentation for networking.
